title: Derived reconstruction of the v1.2 core implementation artifact

acceptance_gates.description: A replacement core artifact exists under docs/spec/ with per-declaration provenance tagging, and no element is presented as recovered v1.2 specification text.
The reconstructed DDL is executable against PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector, and all 25 tables named by v1.2 materialize.

v1.2 hard invariants are enforced by the schema rather than described in prose: event store append-only, RLS enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped table, tenant context fails closed, risk-3/4 tools require approval, and no mutation reaches promoted without a human approver.
Every declaration without source support is enumerated as a decision requiring ADR approval, and the artifact explicitly does not close SRC-001 or unblock FND-DB-DOMAIN.

rollback: Revert the docs/spec commits and the derived-core-schema workflow. No production schema, migration, or cloud resource is created by this package, so rollback has no data implications.
